Beautiful soft studio lighting, precise contact shadows, calm confident product design, slightly elevated three-quarter perspective, sophisticated and minimal. No text, no numbers, no fake UI, no money amounts, no glowing neon, no chains, no generic lock/shield icons, no crypto coin logos. This is a conceptual product illustration, not a screenshot or evidence artifact.
